speaker: Marcus Webb
cascadeSummary: Approved month-nine disbursement of $400,000 for 10 additional households under Deputy Mayor Okoro's authority, bringing total disbursements to $4.6M. Maintained rigorous compliance standards with expanded verification for commercial-residential hybrid cases as directed by the Finance Committee reporting requirements.

statements.decision: Processed disbursement authorization for 10 additional households totaling $400,000
statements.quote: Seventy-nine households stabilized means seventy-nine Oakland families with checks in hand before the displacement notices arrive—every dollar moving with compliance that passes the Finance Committee's scrutiny.
statements.fullStatement: The West Oakland Stabilization Fund has completed its month-nine disbursement review, authorizing $400,000 in stabilization grants to 10 additional households under Deputy Mayor Okoro's authority. This brings total disbursements to approximately $4.6 million of the $28 million authorization, with 79 households now stabilized. Each case file received expanded verification for commercial-residential hybrid eligibility as required by the Finance Committee's reporting framework. All documentation is audit-ready and will be included in this month's mandatory report to the Finance Committee.
